labels: It's just me and Sam watching!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The way you handled everything else, I'm sure it'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean the way you handled everything else?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's our first big performance, Sam. Things never go smoothly...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry. You're right. I'm nervous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll catch you on the other side.
Sam takes a deep breath and enters stage left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Haven't you heard? 'Good luck' is bad luck!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right. Sorry! I meant 'break a leg'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too late now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're just words, Sam. You go out there and do great, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll handle anything that goes... Awry back here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if anything else comes up, I'll take care of it.
The words catch in $ZOE's throat. She clears it then speaks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Good luck?
And Erik, the duct tape around his waist, tries to act with confidence...
But when Erik's hand brushes past his waist, the end piece of the duct tape attaches itself to his finger!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `I would I knew not--Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I would I knew not--Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Bringing his hand up to his face, Erik gets the tape stuck in his hair!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `I knew not why it should be--Agh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I knew not why it should be--Agh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik yanks, trying to free himself from the tape and gets his sleeve caught in it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... I can't watch...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Erik!
Erik shakes his sleeve hard and ends up with both of his arms taped flat against the side of his head. His ripped pants drop down to his ankles!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoops!
Erik shuffles back and forth across the stage, while the audience laughs uproariously.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tighty McWhitey! Um, I mean...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that the, um... Lady who doth come toward your cell?
Emily strides on, and Sam turns back to $ZOE as the play goes on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was a `disaster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That was a [color=#3b78e2][i]disaster![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam pushes Erik and Colt back onstage and watches the scene unfold...
Colt as Count Paris speaks authoritatively...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Now, sir, her father counts it dangerous that she doth give her sorrow so much sway...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Now, sir, her father counts it dangerous that she doth give her sorrow so much sway...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `And in his wisdom hastes our marriage, to stop the inundation of her tears...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And in his wisdom hastes our marriage, to stop the inundation of her tears...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE goes for the boa and wraps it around Erik's waist.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A boa? That's not very Elizabethan, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's what we have. A line of duct tape around the middle wouldn't look very natural. At least they used feathers back in the day.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like it. It makes me look very distinguished. And it works!
He releases his hands, and the outfit stays intact.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now go back out there!
$ZOE grabs the duct tape, tears off a long length of it, and wraps it around Erik's waist.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There. Perfect.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Except for the gray line going around his waist...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least it'll stay on. Being slightly historically inaccurate isn't going to matter if Erik flashes his underwear to the entire crowd.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I should probably warn you that me and tape don't get along well together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too late for that. You need to get out there!
$ZOE is wracked with indecision!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We need, uh... The uh, tape! Get the tape!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What were you saying about things not going wr--
Colt and Erik come up to $ZOE and Sam. Erik is bunching up the fabric of his costume at his waist.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE! Sam! I hast doth tripped upon a strange bough...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Translation, please?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ericson tripped over one of the beams holding up the set and ripped the bottom clear off his pants.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Where?
Erik starts to let go of the bunched up cloth in his hand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. Stop. I don't want to see your... Unmentionables.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I too would prefer to keep my unmentionables uncommented on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't we all? Now what do we do?
$ZOE looks around and spies some duct tape and a thin, white feather boa.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What should I grab?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Naked?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Naked. You know, so they're less intimidating!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... But they'll be `naked` and judging me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huff... Huff... Huff... But they'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]naked[/i][/color] and judging me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll be able to read the judgement... Huff, huff... In their eyes even more!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's getting worse, not better!
Sam steps in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kimi, you're going on in one minute. You have to. If you can't stand people watching you, then you're in luck. You can't see them.
Sam gestures to a gap in the curtain that looks out to the audience.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you see anyone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, huff, huff... It's, huff, dark...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then you can just imagine there's no one there, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... I, huff, guess so!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Get on out there!
Sam pushes Kimi out onstage at her cue. Kimi stumbles onstage, clearly flustered.
There's silence for ten seconds before Kimi pulls it together enough to fumble through her lines...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... `O, huff, woe! Huff! O woeful, woeful, huff, woeful, day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Uh... [color=#3b78e2][i]O, huff, woe! Huff! O woeful, woeful, huff, woeful, day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She can say that again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just... Huff... You and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, like in practice. You delivered all your lines perfectly in practice, and the only audience was me and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's the same thing. No one will be there to judge you or anything.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Isn't it... Huff... Going to be kind of hard to do that... Huff... When there are other people in the audience?
$ZOE smiles and gestures to a gap in the curtain.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, look through here. Can you see anyone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, it's really dark out there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So it should be pretty easy to imagine that it's me and Sam in the darkness, right?
Kimi nods.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great. You ready to go on?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah!
She walks on stage right on cue and starts performing her lines without hitch!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `O woe! O woeful, woeful, woeful day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O woe! O woeful, woeful, woeful day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
Sam gives $ZOE a pleading look.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just pretend everyone's naked!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means, we need Friar Lawrence, Montague, Lady Montague, Capulet, and Lady Capulet out there right now, mourning for their children.
The named actors start filing out of the dressing room. Spencer lumbers up to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not you, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes!
Sam plucks Erik out of the crowd of actors moving to the front.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik Ericson! Can you just do me a favor and give Spencer a signal when he needs to get onstage? He's on when you're not.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm happy to be of service! You know my mother says I've always been helpful...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Thanks!
The next ten minutes hurry by as Kevin coordinates the opening sets and cues up the music.
When the curtain opens, everyone is in place!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `For I will raise her statue in pure gold... That while Verona by that name is known, there shall no figure at such rate be set...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]For I will raise her statue in pure gold... That while Verona by that name is known, there shall no figure at such rate be set...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `As that of true and faithful Juliet`...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]As that of true and faithful Juliet[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: While the play happens smoothly onstage...
Backstage, Sam is all nerves. $ZOE pats her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey... You okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm great, I'm fine, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, no. I'm terrible! I hate this!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My stomach's tied in knots. And there's this pounding in, like, my `brain.`
nodes.text_bbcode: My stomach's tied in knots. And there's this pounding in, like, my [color=#3b78e2][i]brain.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you upset about? Is it the play? Because that's pretty normal...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not just about that. It's about Nick and the play.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nick?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... He and I... Haven't really been talking. I mean, I forgave him for calling me 'Sara', but I don't know if I can ever `forget` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... He and I... Haven't really been talking. I mean, I forgave him for calling me 'Sara', but I don't know if I can ever [color=#3b78e2][i]forget[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... I'm sure you'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure... `Maybe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, sure... [color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And of course with all this play stuff... I just keep thinking about Andrew's play and how good it was. What if mine doesn't measure up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if I don't win? My mom's out there, and she's going to be so disappointed if the play's a mess. What if changing up the play is a bad idea?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Changing the play around wasn't a bad idea, Sam. It shifts the focus. It makes it less about Romeo and Juliet's destiny, and more about their romance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: By focusing on the kiss, you're focusing on a love so powerful, it changed two houses for the better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Yeah. You're right. Ms. Macbeth will appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope that the play goes smoothly, and nothing goes wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... Nothing's going to go wr--
Suddenly, Emily races over to them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily? What's wrong? You're supposed to be 'dead' on the bed! You're going on again in ten minutes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know, but there's kind of a problem! I'm not sure what happened, but Kimi suddenly has a bad case of nerves. She doesn't want to go on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She and I both.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily, get ready for your next scene. We'll find her.
It takes $ZOE and Sam a few precious minutes to find Kimi, but they track her down near the rack of prop weapons.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, guys... I really want to go out, but I just think of all those people out there, and... It's just so embarrassing!
Kimi starts hyperventilating.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's she doing? What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, just relax...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... Huff... Tried that! Being relaxed is... Huff... Hard when you're, uh, not! So many people... Huff... Out there, watching me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, you know all the lines. You've been practicing really hard. Just because there are people out there doesn't mean you'll do badly...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Doesn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE... Ben just 'killed' Colt. The scene's wrapping up. We're going to a flashback with Juliet and the Nurse. I need her to go on in two minutes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huff! Huff!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, just imagine that...

options.label: It's just me and Sam watching!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Deaths... Kiss... `Jokes?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Deaths... Kiss... [color=#e23b3b][i]Jokes?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jokes? There are jokes in the play?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! That's new!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did any of my audition material make it in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jokes?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Samface, $ZOEperson, I don't want to annoy you, but... The only person who tells jokes is Erik.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And they're not funny.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There are no jokes! $ZOE is just being really confusing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deaths. Duel. Kiss.` Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths. Duel. Kiss.[/i][/color] Got it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kiss... Duel... Death?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, yeah! I remember how the play goes now! Romeo and Juliet kiss, I duel you, and then they die!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, wait a minute...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's the original version of the play. We changed it. $ZOE is just being really confusing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You lost me again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Deaths. Duel. Kiss.` Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths. Duel. Kiss.[/i][/color] Got it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unlike the original script, instead of ending with Romeo and Juliet's deaths, we're `starting` with them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlike the original script, instead of ending with Romeo and Juliet's deaths, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]starting[/i][/color] with them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now repeat after me... `Death. Duel. Kiss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now repeat after me... [color=#3b78e2][i]Death. Duel. Kiss![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A chorus of 'Deaths, duel, kiss!' rises from the assembled crowd, and $ZOE nods. Sam looks visibly relieved.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And one last time... `Deaths. Duel. Kiss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And one last time... [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths. Duel. Kiss![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And of course there's always the theme of missed communication. I get weird messages from Paige's phone... I can't talk to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Romeo and Juliet couldn't get ahold of each other... And we all saw how that ended. Romeo poisons himself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dark stuff.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, I know that you're trying to reach her. I'm sorry that you can't seem to get close enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Try not to get hurt, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't. I know she's trying to reach me too...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just hope she's more successful.
While Sam and her group break before the big play that evening...
Across the city, Paige finally reaches the borders of the city of Centerscore!
Having just crawled through mud to escape Monarch Prep, she sets off in the direction of Owen's house, each step taking her closer and closer...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm coming, Owen... And you'd `better` be ready for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm coming, Owen... And you'd [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] be ready for me!

nodes.text: That evening, at the theater...
It's absolute chaos backstage as everyone in Sam's production scrambles around in the dressing room, preparing for their first and only show!
Some people get ready in front of the mirror...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Makeup emergency! I need red lipstick over here, stat!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have red `hair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have red [color=#3b78e2][i]hair![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, not now, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I have lipstick, Taylor!
Taylor gives Kimi the once-over and scowls.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not you either. I wouldn't want to end up in one of your spreadsheets.
While others put on their costumes...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, Denni... Need any help zipping up that dress?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't touch me, Ryan, or I'll zip `you` up, and it won't be pleasant.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't touch me, Ryan, or I'll zip [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] up, and it won't be pleasant.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Also, dude! I'm `right` here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, dude! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color] here!

nodes.text: Colt stands up menacingly and edges towards Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, okay. You're very macho. Now let's get you into these tights.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously? I'm not wearing any stockings unless it's on my face.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do I even want to know?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Has anyone seen my minstrel's lute?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you need a lute for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've been doing method acting, Benjamin Kale, and in my heart, I know that Friar Lawrence desperately wants to be a bard. He was born to it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think that's what he does after he accidentally helps kill Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
And at the helm of the ship, $ZOE and Sam try to get everyone organized.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen up! Ten minutes to showtime! Anyone acting in the first scene needs to report backstage!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Is that me and Ben?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This question again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got this, Sam.
She turns to the assembled actors.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's confusing, but please try to pay attention to the order of the play.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even though I'll be cuing people to go on, I won't be able to pull this off without your help. Now the general order of the play is...

nodes.prompt: The general order of the play is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: The general order of the play is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Unrequited?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't that what it's called when you're pining away for someone, but you don't know how they feel?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know how she feels about me. She likes me. She has to.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige can come off as mean and cruel, but I know what we have is real.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Of course Paige likes you. It's just that you two can't be together right now even though you want to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what Romeo and Juliet is all about. That's why it speaks to you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, you and Paige are two people in love, separated by circumstances beyond your control.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That about sums it up...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. No wonder the play makes so much sense.
$ZOE trails off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The theme of what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, unrequited love?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You guys know your parts backwards and forwards... Well, by tonight, you'll know them `forwards and backwards!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys know your parts backwards and forwards... Well, by tonight, you'll know them [color=#3b78e2][i]forwards and backwards![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And of course, I'll be backstage making sure everyone gets to their parts on time and everything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're sorry to spring this on you at the last moment, but we'll all do great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's do a run-through, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First, the `deaths` of Romeo and Juliet... Next, the infamous `duel` between Tybalt, Romeo, and Mercutio...
nodes.text_bbcode: First, the [color=#3b78e2][i]deaths[/i][/color] of Romeo and Juliet... Next, the infamous [color=#3b78e2][i]duel[/i][/color] between Tybalt, Romeo, and Mercutio...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And `then` the `kiss` at the party! Places everyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]then[/i][/color] the [color=#3b78e2][i]kiss[/i][/color] at the party! Places everyone!

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
Backstage, $ZOE looks at the new notes on the script that Sam has made.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Deaths, duel, kiss... Deaths, duel, kiss...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Deaths, duel, kiss... Deaths, duel, kiss...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Quite a lethal combination of words there, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, Owen... Just trying to make sure `I` know the order before I tell other people to get on stage and perform.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, Owen... Just trying to make sure [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know the order before I tell other people to get on stage and perform.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll do great. Being organized is what you do best.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I just hope we'll all be able to pull off the new order of this play...
$ZOE and Owen look back at the stage where Sam is yelling at Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Leaping out to attack you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not supposed to leap out during the `balcony scene!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not supposed to leap out during the [color=#3b78e2][i]balcony scene![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How am I supposed to know that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have a `cue.` Don't come out until Erik leaves the stage.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have a [color=#3b78e2][i]cue.[/i][/color] Don't come out until Erik leaves the stage.

nodes.text: Sulkily, Spencer walks backstage, and Sam turns to Emily and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now you two, kiss!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait, that's right `now?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, that's right [color=#3b78e2][i]now?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE sighs heavily.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, a few more run-throughs, and it'll be natural, I'm sure.
They look back at the stage and see Emily and Ben kiss on the balcony.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like that. That's completely natural.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `More` passion!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]More[/i][/color] passion!

nodes.text: Ben tilts his head and frames Emily's face with his hands. The kiss is tender and deep.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...They are `way` too good.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...They are [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad it's convincing. It's good Ben and Emily agreed to be the stars of the show.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Because they're not afraid to kiss onstage?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, that's exactly it. They throw so much of themselves into that kiss. It really sells to the audience how strong their love is.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow. That's deep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. I try. So how's learning the lines? Being the understudy for every guy isn't an easy task. You said you were having some trouble last time we talked.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... I've read the play the entire way through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, that's a good start... But what about the memorization?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's going surprisingly well. It `was` rough at first, but it got a lot easier since Ben and Spencer keep asking for prompts every scene. I know both their parts really well.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's going surprisingly well. It [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] rough at first, but it got a lot easier since Ben and Spencer keep asking for prompts every scene. I know both their parts really well.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...As for the others, well, if something bad happens then I'm pretty sure I can write them on my hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay. I'm sure this must be your favorite play by now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's kind of a depressing play. But in a weird way, it speaks to me. It reminds me of Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it would make sense that you would say that given the theme of...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, Amanda, really?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If we're keeping our roles, then are our lines changing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't memorize `another` set of lines! No one has time for that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't memorize [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] set of lines! No one has time for that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think what Sam means is that you already know your lines!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So it'll be pretty easy to act once you know where to start.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're not asking you to relearn an entirely new play...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just to recite the lines you already know in different places!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So it'll be pretty easy to act out the rest of the scene once you know where to start.
Sam blanks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... It'll be easy because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because you know your roles!
The gathered actors are quiet... Then all of them burst into chatter!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Out of order? What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Out of order! A reversal of the play. It's too late to make everyone switch genders, but that doesn't mean we can't still go along with the `theme` of reversals.
nodes.text_bbcode: Out of order! A reversal of the play. It's too late to make everyone switch genders, but that doesn't mean we can't still go along with the [color=#3b78e2][i]theme[/i][/color] of reversals.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If Ms. Macbeth wants to see reversals, there will be `reversals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: If Ms. Macbeth wants to see reversals, there will be [color=#3b78e2][i]reversals![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh-oh, uh-oh! I don't deal well with sudden change!
Erik begins breathing heavily.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is it too bright in here? Am I still human? Where am I!
Owen claps Erik hard on the back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Breathe, Ericson. Breathe. You'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Change! I love change!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So with this new script... Does this mean we can put in a scene where I kiss Lady Capulet?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You `wish.` There is `nowhere` in the play where you'd be kissing my character!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]wish.[/i][/color] There is [color=#3b78e2][i]nowhere[/i][/color] in the play where you'd be kissing my character!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As if I'd let him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does that mean we'd be switching roles too? I can be other things than just the Nurse, I promise!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I am a little confused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What does that even mean? How are we doing that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, the theme of my play is about 'reversals'. But the only reversal in my play is that I'm playing the male character Tybalt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to rearrange the play so that the deaths come first, and then we recount the story of Romeo and Juliet's love.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last and most important scene will be their `kiss` on the balcony.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last and most important scene will be their [color=#3b78e2][i]kiss[/i][/color] on the balcony.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Do I still get to do my sword-fighting scene?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! And don't worry too much guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it'll be easy because you already...
That night, Sam and the rest of the troop put on 'Romeo and Juliet With Vampires: And Sam'!
Onstage, Emily as Juliet soliloquizes above Ben as Romeo. Ben lies still in a fake tomb, pretending to be dead.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `This... Is my sheath!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]This... Is my sheath![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just as Emily's about to plunge the prop dagger into her heart, Ben snaps up from the tomb he lays on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Uhn... Uhhhhhnnnn...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uhn... Uhhhhhnnnn...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My heart!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My heart![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Hark, thy blood... Thy blooooodddddd...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hark, thy blood... Thy blooooodddddd...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Ben hisses at Emily in what sounds like Shakespearean pentameter, Sam watches nervously from just behind the curtains.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How do you think it's going? I can't tell. I'm so nervous...
$ZOE scans the faces of people in the audience. Ms. Macbeth, in particular, looks unimpressed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Sam. I just don't know.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Thy disgusting teeth, thy undead hunger... Taste the flesh of your living Juliet...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thy disgusting teeth, thy undead hunger... Taste the flesh of your living Juliet...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `So you taketh love... To immortal end!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So you taketh love... To immortal end![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Bloooodddd... Loveth thy blood...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bloooodddd... Loveth thy blood...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben bites Emily's neck as the curtain closes over them.
When the curtain rises and the actors take a bow, there is lukewarm reception from the audience.
Ms. Macbeth and Andrew approach Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what'd you think?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, it's clear you put a lot of effort into your production.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: ...But it lacks originality.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It is indeed a play most foul! Your entire ending is just a farce, a copy of the ending to my play!
Ms. Macbeth silences him with a look.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: While I don't approve of Andrew's strong wording, he is correct. Your interpretation, Sam, has nothing new to offer.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I have no choice but to name Andrew the winner of the scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But--!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I won? I won!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of course I won!
Andrew turns to Sam with a smirk.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'd say it was a pleasure, but it was the exact opposite.
Sam doesn't even have a witty quip back as Andrew smugly goes on about the superiority of his play.
In her heart, Sam knows that...
She has failed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vampires?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Vampires? That's so... Four years ago.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, Andrew pulled off his play with supernatural creatures really well last night.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I figure that I can do that too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where is the vampire plot in Romeo and Juliet?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, it's like the Montagues and the Capulets are two warring vampire houses... We put in a couple battles, it'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `YEAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YEAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And for the next several hours, they practice with the new vampire plot element...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yours? Pfft! Please! The only thing you've got going is role reversal, and `you're` the only one in the entire cast with a reversed role.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yours? Pfft! Please! The only thing you've got going is role reversal, and [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] the only one in the entire cast with a reversed role.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're a washed up hack!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me... `One` of us has a successful play to celebrate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now if you'll excuse me... [color=#e23b3b][i]One[/i][/color] of us has a successful play to celebrate.

nodes.text: He walks away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That guy!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah. He seems to get worse every time I see him. Does he ever stop talking?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Probably not... But what he said is right... My play's just `me` doing a role reversal.
nodes.text_bbcode: Probably not... But what he said is right... My play's just [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] doing a role reversal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I need to change things up... And quick!
The next morning, at the afternoon rehearsal right before the show...
Sam and $ZOE stand on the stage in front of the assembled actors. $ZOE clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Listen up, everyone... You've all done a great job these last couple weeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But as of last night, we realized that we have to make a couple changes to the script...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No... I barely know my part as it is!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This has to do with Andrew's play, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. If we're going to do better than Andrew's production--

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which was `awesome...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which was [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: --Then we're going to have to change things around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I decided that we're going to perform Romeo and Juliet...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was a lot of fun! I thought zombies made the entire action of the Romeo and Juliet story more intense and exciting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the ending was just great! It was brilliant that the zombies talked in the same style!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It was a challenge encouraging my zombie cast to only moan in ten syllables!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: The level of detail in your play shows an enthusiasm for both the art and the prose. Well done, Andrew. I'm quite impressed.
Andrew shoots Sam a smug smile.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Maybe I `shouldn't` have been so nice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]shouldn't[/i][/color] have been so nice...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: At any rate, I must jot down some notes for the scholarship. Sam, I am very excited to see how your play fares.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Especially after Andrew's `brilliant` production!
nodes.text_bbcode: Especially after Andrew's [color=#3b78e2][i]brilliant[/i][/color] production!

nodes.text: She waves good-bye to both of them and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Did you hear that? It was `brilliant.` Thanks for putting the words right in her mouth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you hear that? It was [color=#e23b3b][i]brilliant.[/i][/color] Thanks for putting the words right in her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, Sam, you could have been a little less effusive with your enthusiasm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. Just because Andrew's play was good doesn't mean mine isn't going to be `better.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. Just because Andrew's play was good doesn't mean mine isn't going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]better.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was a pretty good adaptation, and the zombies were a fun addition...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But the ending seemed to confuse the theme of the entire play. Their deaths were supposed to heal the rift between the two houses... But instead, the plague plunged everything into chaos.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What was the new theme? It wasn't as clear to me.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Interesting! I do think you're right. While the technical aspects of the play and the smaller details were well done...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It does seem to undermine the main spirit of the play. Thank you for that critique.
Andrew shoots Sam an angry glare.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Grrr...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: At any rate, I must jot down some notes for the scholarship. Sam, I am very excited to see how your play fares.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: We shall see how well `you` capture Shakespeare's main theme.
nodes.text_bbcode: We shall see how well [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] capture Shakespeare's main theme.

nodes.text: She waves good-bye to both of them and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Thanks a `lot`, Sam.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color], Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was my pleasure.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I don't need your smug pleasantries. And your opinion's worth nothing to me! My play is a masterpiece.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And yours will be a `joke.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And yours will be a [color=#e23b3b][i]joke.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It will not! It's going to be `better.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It will not! It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]better.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam rails against Andrew's play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think it was all that great. The zombies were a horrible addition to the entire play.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it didn't make that much sense. Come on, a plague in that era? There weren't any zombies!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The entire play just seemed like a superficial shrine to showcase Andrew's otherwise lame talents.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I didn't find it to be 'lame' as you say. I thought it was very well done and true to the Shakespearean spirit.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: And while I understand that Andrew is your competition, Sam, it's very `unsportmanlike` of you to tear apart his production.
nodes.text_bbcode: And while I understand that Andrew is your competition, Sam, it's very [color=#3b78e2][i]unsportmanlike[/i][/color] of you to tear apart his production.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I only hope yours fares better.
Ms. Macbeth turns and leaves them. Andrew smiles smugly at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Looks like `someone` was put in their rightful place.
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like [color=#e23b3b][i]someone[/i][/color] was put in their rightful place.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oh yeah, it's you. It was you all along, `shrew.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, it's you. It was you all along, [color=#e23b3b][i]shrew.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up. Maybe I went a little overboard, but what I said is based off the truth.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your opinion's worth nothing to me! My play is a masterpiece.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And yours will be a `joke.`

nodes.text: $ZOE and Owen look at one another, breathing hard and taking everything in. Owen whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How do you think we did?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, lovebirds! Hurry up and come down for the final bow!
$ZOE and Owen carefully scramble down from their places on the balcony and join the other actors.
When the curtain rises and the actors take a bow, there is a loud and thunderous applause from the audience!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
Owen bows, grinning at the crowd... And he notices a familiar figure storming up the aisle towards the doors...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Paige?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the matter? Did you see someone?
Owen looks back to the crowd again, but the figure is gone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought I did... But I guess not...
Then the curtain closes.
You are now playing as Sam.
Backstage, Sam waits anxiously with $ZOE and Kevin as the auditorium empties out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What did you think? It wasn't too dramatic, was it?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Are you kidding? They loved it! I can still hear the applause! This was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have a good feeling about this...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Samantha! Look who I found!
Sam turns to see her mom, Ms. Macbeth, and Andrew approach. Sam's mom puts a supportive arm around her daughter.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Time to face the music...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what'd you think, Ms. Macbeth?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was wonderful! Spectacular! The inversion of the play was unique and entertaining!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: It was so well put together! It really highlighted the love between Romeo and Juliet as the core emotion of the play.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Having watched both your plays, I'm honored to announce that the Shakespeare Scholarship Federation is proud to honor Sam with the distinguished 'Romeo and Juliet' award!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: This is such great news, Ms. Macbeth! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, thank you, thank you, thank you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did it, Sam! Congratulations!
Sam, $ZOE, and her mother hug each other, as Andrew fumes beside them.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What?! But what about the commotion in the final act? The switching of the players?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: I admire the ability to move on despite setbacks. And switching the actors out... Well, it was an inspired move that emphasized the universality of the play.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Aren't we all Romeo and Juliet in our own way with our own tragic backstory and our own romances and escapades?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I can't believe this! Spencer missed his cue and destroyed half the set! It was... It was simply unprofessional!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd you know Spencer missed his cue?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Anyone could have guessed with that `fool` in the wings. And with Erik giving him stage directions, it's like the blind leading the buffoon!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyone could have guessed with that [color=#e23b3b][i]fool[/i][/color] in the wings. And with Erik giving him stage directions, it's like the blind leading the buffoon!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd you know Erik was in charge of giving him stage directions?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Er... Anyone... Could... Guess?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Andrew... I'm afraid we're going to have to have a `long` chat about what is professional... And what is `not.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Andrew... I'm afraid we're going to have to have a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] chat about what is professional... And what is [color=#3b78e2][i]not.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth hauls Andrew away with her.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I did nothing that Iago wouldn't have done!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good morrow to you, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah! You deserved it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if it weren't for you guys... None of this would have happened...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if I can ever repay you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can start! Who wants a meat pizza? My treat!
The next morning, before school, Sam is sitting at a lunch table, trying to muster some excitement for her S.E.T. prep.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm thrilled I can afford college now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that means I actually have to `try` to get a good score on the S.E.T.s.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that means I actually have to [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to get a good score on the S.E.T.s.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course, I don't know why that can't wait until tomorrow...
She throws her pencil into the crack of her book, but misses. It rolls down the length of the table and falls...
Into Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Aren't you forgetting something?
Nick stands across from her, a bouquet of red roses in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey. What are `those` for?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey. What are [color=#3b78e2][i]those[/i][/color] for?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For being the prettiest Tybalt to ever grace a production of Romeo and Juliet. I watched your play last night. It was great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I tried to look for you after the show, but I didn't see you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I went out with $ZOE and Kevin. Sorry, I know we haven't really been hanging out--
He shakes his head and puts a hand on her arm.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't have to apologize. Actually, I kind of get it. I wouldn't want to hang out with me either if you called me 'Sara'...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha. I said you were forgiven.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sometimes we forgive, but we're still hurting.
Sam looks down.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Look, sir, here comes the lady towards my cell![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily strides on, and Sam turns back to $ZOE, relieved.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm glad `that's` over...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm glad [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] over...

nodes.title: The Show Must Go On
nodes.subtitle: Can Sam beat Andrew and win the scholarship?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Sam.
Sam, $ZOE, and Kevin are sitting front and center at the stage production of 'Romeo and Juliet With Zombies: And Andrew'!
Onstage, Jenna as Juliet soliloquizes above Andrew as Romeo. Andrew lies still in a fake tomb, pretending to be dead.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `This... Is my sheath!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]This... Is my sheath![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just as Jenna's about to plunge the prop dagger into her heart, Andrew lumbers up from the tomb he lays on...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Un... Uhnnn...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Un... Uhnnn...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My love!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo! You're... You're doth alive! My love![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Hark, thy brains... Thy braaaaainsss...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hark, thy brains... Thy braaaaainsss...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: While Andrew makes zombie moans in iambic pentameter, $ZOE leans over to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I literally have no idea where the end of this play is going to go...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shhh! This is exactly the part I've been waiting to see...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Thou detestable maw, thy rotten jaws... Cram thy mouth upon your fair Juliet...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thou detestable maw, thy rotten jaws... Cram thy mouth upon your fair Juliet...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `So plague taketh love... To its timely end!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]So plague taketh love... To its timely end![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Braaaains... Loveth thy brains...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Braaaains... Loveth thy brains...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew shuffles over to Jenna and pretends to consume her brains...
And the curtain closes.
Applause resounds loudly through the theater.
Ms. Macbeth stands, excitedly bringing her hands together.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Bravo!
A few seats down, $ZOE, Sam, and Kevin stand up and head into the lobby of the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That was actually awesome! I don't even know where they stored all that stage blood, but it was `so` gruesomely realistic!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was actually awesome! I don't even know where they stored all that stage blood, but it was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] gruesomely realistic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The part where Hannah says, `an undead plague upon both your houses`, was a pretty good line.
nodes.text_bbcode: The part where Hannah says, [color=#3b78e2][i]an undead plague upon both your houses[/i][/color], was a pretty good line.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And the way the zombies shambled after their victims and fed on their heads...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `So` surprisingly good.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] surprisingly good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, great.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You didn't like it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I `loved` it. I `love` zombie anything, really. But... It's `Andrew's play.` This is what we'll be competing against tomorrow evening when we perform.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I [color=#3b78e2][i]loved[/i][/color] it. I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] zombie anything, really. But... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Andrew's play.[/i][/color] This is what we'll be competing against tomorrow evening when we perform.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And everyone was so into it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: His play wasn't `that` great...
nodes.text_bbcode: His play wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] great...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you're trying to make me feel better, $ZOE. It's okay that Andrew's play was successful.
There's a slow clap behind her, and Sam glares at Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Admitting your defeat already? You can always withdraw. It's never too late.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, Andrew, how do you keep slithering up that way?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Probably the same way you keep managing to meddle in my affairs, `shrew!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Probably the same way you keep managing to meddle in my affairs, [color=#e23b3b][i]shrew![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam bites back whatever choice words she has to say to Andrew when she spots Ms. Macbeth walking over to them.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Andrew, congratulations on a theatrical success!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Why, thank you, Ms. Macbeth! I strive for excellent theater.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Unlike `others` in my peer category...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlike [color=#e23b3b][i]others[/i][/color] in my peer category...

nodes.text: He sneers at Sam, and $ZOE puts her arm on Sam's hand to stop her cousin from growling.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Sam, what did you think of the play?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I enjoyed it, but I `probably` shouldn't tell Ms. Macbeth that... Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, I enjoyed it, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]probably[/i][/color] shouldn't tell Ms. Macbeth that... Right?

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
